bear_assumptions: Organic contraction persists, client and Clover execution disappoint, margins compress and debt limits capital returns, sustaining a reset multiple.
base_assumptions: 2026 remains a reset year, but essential processing retention and Clover stabilization support a gradual 2027 recovery with manageable debt and cash conversion.
bull_assumptions: Clover growth reaccelerates, client remediation works, organic growth and margins normalize, free cash flow strengthens and the earnings multiple partially recovers.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after sequential organic growth, cash conversion and an accepted relationship clear all gates; downgrade if contraction, client losses, leverage or execution failures persist beyond the reset period.
